summary: Frontend-only verification of two implemented fixes (blog detail page + contact inline validation) plus regression checks. All target items pass.

test_results.contact_empty_submit: PASS - All 5 inline errors present (contact-error-name/email/service/budget/message) with proper German messages; page does not silently do nothing
test_results.contact_partial_submit: PASS - Only contact-error-service and contact-error-budget show when name/email/message filled

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both fixes verified end-to-end on production preview URL. Contact selects are native <select> elements (SELECT tag) - use select_option with values like 'web-development' / '5k-10k'. Blog slugs may contain URL-encoded characters (e.g. 'ü'), but Playwright navigation handles it correctly. Chatbot floating widget intentionally absent per user decision - do not report.
